messages:
Mira: quick check — VendorX says eu-west3 rack with H100s could be available starting next Tue. Can we reserve 4 H100s for the `dedicated-benchmark` pool for our perf runs? Also looks like project quota might be limited. @Sam @Devin ?
Sam: do we need reserved (dedicated) capacity or temporary burst? reserved will need PO and lead time.
Devin: current quotas show only 2 H100 accelerators on project redwood-prod-eu. If we need 4 we'll need a quota increase + vendor allocation. I can open the quota request now if you confirm dates.
Mira: tests are scheduled Wed–Thu next week (21–22). Ideally reserved for the week so test retries don't get throttled. If reserved isn't possible, burst will work but we lose repeatability.
Lee: short fallback plan — we can run mixed A100+H100 split: 2 H100 + 4 A100 for the same throughput in the short term. config snippet to spin up a temporary pool:```infractl pool create dedicated-benchmark --region=eu-west3 --gpus=2xH100,4xA100 --node-count=3 --labels=bench=perf```
Ana: procurement-bot has been pinged — if we go reserved we need a PO. vendor quotes need PO number + billing contact.
procurement-bot: Ticket created: PRO-5421 assigned to Ana. VendorX needs PO and signed SOW before rack hold can be guaranteed. ETA vendor-side: ~4 business days after PO.
Sam: I can file the quota request now (gcloud quota update). Command I used before: `gcloud compute project-info describe --project=redwood-prod-eu` to inspect quotas, then open support case with cloud vendor. I'll cc @Ana in the support request.
Devin: re: quota, if someone needs to run an emergency perf, I can temporarily bump the project to the demo-override quota (low risk) — but that requires oncall approval.
Mira: ok let's do this plan: 1) Sam files quota request today 2) Ana submits PO to VendorX (PRO-5421) 3) Devin prepares fallback A100 mix (Lee's snippet) if we only get 2 H100s. I'll update the perf schedule if anything slips.
Sam: filing quota request now, will paste case id when done.
Ana: started PO draft, need final billing contact and amount. Mira can you confirm the cost estimate or link to the perf run PR?
Mira: PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/perf-runs/pull/342 — cost estimate in the PR description. Billing contact: finance+cloud@redwood.com.
Sam: quota case submitted — case 1234567890 with cloud vendor. Fingers crossed. :crossed_fingers:
Devin: noted. I'll set up the mixed-pool playbook and a runbook step to fallback automatically if only 2 H100s are provisioned.
Lee: :thumbsup: when you have the case id and PO number, drop them here and I'll coordinate the infra-side reservation.
Mira: thanks all — will follow up in the perf PR and PRO-5421 thread.
